body: Chief: codec slice 1 review is in — ACCEPT-WITH-NITS (the post-hoc ack stands; nothing to revert). Verified by the reviewer with 5000-run mutation probes: no accepted wire string breaks encode(decode(s)) == s; key and value decoders agree; AddressString fully gone; build.sbt dep is exactly laws % "test->compile". Follow-ups for codex-storymodel4s-root, fold into slice 2's candidate (same bead): (1) CodecSuite:184-188 — the 'accepted wire string is a fixed point' property only generates canonical renderings, so it duplicates the law at :49; forAll over a mutation generator (lowercase hex, %41-for-unreserved, doubled/trailing '/', fullwidth and Arabic-Indic digits, %FF, NFC/NFD) asserting decode(s).forall(a => encode(a) == s); (2) pin the guard: add %２F (fullwidth) and %FF (invalid UTF-8 → U+FFFD) to the reject list at :192-198 — core/address.scala:82-85 Character.digit accepts non-ASCII digits and :101 maps invalid UTF-8 to U+FFFD, so today only codec's fixed-point guard rejects them (core hardening is a separate bead I will file); (3) factor one private canonical(rendered) and derive both decoders (core.scala:73-85). Then propose slice 2 (FeatureTrack sidecars) on the board — codec/features.scala is under my features reservation until my merge; discuss the sidecar shape with codex-storyatlas-root first.
